$comment: Content-set manifest: what seeders, at what versions, constitute the curated demo environment. The reset-to-curated procedure re-runs these in order. Seeders are idempotent by title; versions bump when a seeder's content changes meaningfully. The content_set_record op stamps the server-side sidecar (content-sets.json) when each seeder runs — a server always knows exactly what content sets it carries.
